qualification.reason: This document is a Request for Quotes (RFQ) issued by the New York State Department of Taxation and Finance for GPS hardware and software, including installation and software support. It contains procurement-specific elements such as a bid due date, scope of work, submission instructions, evaluation criteria, and administrative requirements.

quotes.quote: REQUEST FOR QUOTES
TITLE: GPS Hardware and Software
REQUEST FOR QUOTE NUMBER: 19-326
The New York State Department of Taxation and Finance (“DTF” or “Department”) has a need to monitor and manage a fleet of approximately ninety-three (93) vehicles.
Responses to this RFQ must be emailed to BFS.Contracts@tax.ny.gov no later than October 8, 2019 at 2:00 PM ET.

findings.title: Offerer must affirm compliance with procurement lobbying guidelines
findings.fact: The Offerer must affirm it has read, understands and agrees to comply with the DTF guidelines relative to permissible contacts as required by State Finance Law.

quotes.quote: Offerer affirms it has read, understands and agrees to comply with the guidelines of the New York State Department of Taxation and Finance relative to permissible contacts as required by the State Finance Law §§139-j(3) and 139-j(6)(b).

findings.title: Offerer must certify completeness and accuracy of information under State Finance Law 139-k
findings.fact: The Offerer must certify that all information provided to the DTF with respect to State Finance Law §139-k is complete, true and accurate.

quotes.quote: I certify that all information provided to the DTF with respect to State Finance Law §139-k is complete, true and accurate.

findings.title: Offerer must disclose prior non-responsibility determinations
findings.fact: The Offerer must disclose any prior non-responsibility determinations, including terminations due to intentional provision of false or incomplete information.

quotes.quote: Has any New York State agency or authority terminated a Procurement Contract with the Offerer due to the intentional provision of false or incomplete information?

findings.title: Total Cost Calculation
findings.fact: The total cost will be calculated using the information provided on Attachment 1, Quote Response Form.

quotes.quote: The total cost will be calculated using the information provided on Attachment 1, Quote Response Form.

findings.title: Tie-Breaking Rule: Earliest Bid
findings.fact: In the event of tie bids, the earliest bid received shall determine the winner.

quotes.quote: In the event tie bids are received by the Department, the earliest bid received shall determine the winner.

findings.title: Reserved Right to Determine Tie-Breaking Mechanism
findings.fact: The Department reserves the right to determine a tie breaking mechanism for award, to be set prior to bid opening, to serve the best interests of the State.

quotes.quote: Determine a tie breaking mechanism for award, to be set prior bid opening, to serve the best interests of the State.

findings.title: Reserved Right to Reject Proposals
findings.fact: The Department reserves the right to evaluate, accept and/or reject any and all proposals, in whole or in part, and to waive technicalities, irregularities, and omissions if in the Department's judgment the best interests of the Department will be served.

quotes.quote: Evaluate, accept and/or reject any and all proposals, in whole or in part, and to waive technicalities, irregularities, and omissions if, in the Department’s judgment, the best interests of the Department will be served.

findings.title: Payment Milestones and Percentages
findings.fact: The RFQ does not specify payment milestones or percentages; payment is based on invoices submitted by the awarded Bidder.

quotes.quote: Payment for invoices submitted by the awarded Bidder shall only be rendered electronically unless payment by paper check is expressly authorized by the Commissioner, at the Commissioner’s sole discretion, due to extenuating circumstances.

findings.title: Invoice Processing Timelines
findings.fact: The RFQ does not specify a timeline for invoice processing; it only states that payment will be made in accordance with Article 11-A of New York State Finance Law.

quotes.quote: Payment will be made only upon submission of proper invoices by the awarded Bidder, and in accordance with Article 11-A of New York State Finance Law.

findings.title: Liquidated Damages (LD) Rates and Caps
findings.fact: The RFQ does not contain any liquidated damages provisions.

quotes.quote: The bid must be fully and properly executed by an authorized person. By signing you certify your express authority to sign on behalf of yourself, your company, or other entity and full knowledge and acceptance of this REQUEST FOR QUOTES, Appendix A (Standard Clauses For New York State Contracts), and that all information provided is complete, true and accurate.

findings.title: SLA Penalties and Metrics
findings.fact: The RFQ does not specify SLA penalties or metrics; it only requires ongoing support and maintenance with no cost for replacements within 30 days.

quotes.quote: If any devices are identified by the Department to require maintenance or replacement, not resulting from the negligence of any DTF employee, the devices and/or services must be provided to the Department at no cost within 30 days of the Department’s notification.

findings.title: Warranty Period Obligations
findings.fact: The RFQ does not explicitly state a warranty period, but requires ongoing support and maintenance throughout the term, including no-cost replacement of devices within 30 days.

quotes.quote: The Department will require ongoing support throughout the term of the Agreement, including any necessary maintenance to the hardware to keep the equipment and systems operational and up-to-date.

findings.title: Taxes, Duties, and Fee Structures
findings.fact: The RFQ does not mention taxes, duties, or fee structures beyond requiring prices to be inclusive of all costs and guaranteed for the term.

quotes.quote: Charges for travel cannot be listed as separate line items on the bid response form. The prices bid for each item must be inclusive of all costs.
Prices as they appear on submitted bids must be guaranteed by the vendor for the term of the Agreement.

findings.title: Taxes, Duties, and Fee Structures
findings.fact: The document requires certification of registration to collect sales and compensating use tax, and failure to certify is a material breach.

quotes.quote: CERTIFICATION OF REGISTRATION TO COLLECT SALES AND COMPENSATING USE TAX BY CERTAIN STATE CONTRACTORS, AFFILIATES AND SUBCONTRACTORS. To the extent this agreement is a contract as defined by Tax Law Section 5-a, if the contractor fails to make the certification required by Tax Law Section 5-a or if during the term of the contract, the Department of Taxation and Finance or the covered agency, as defined by Tax Law 5-a, discovers that the certification, made under penalty of perjury, is false, then such failure to file or false certification shall be a material breach of this contract and this contract may be terminated, by providing written notification to the Contractor in accordance with the terms of the agreement, if the covered agency determines that such action is in the best interest of the State.

findings.title: Minimum Qualifications: Original Manufacturer or Authorized Reseller
findings.fact: Bidders must be the original manufacturer or authorized reseller of the hardware and software to be provided.
findings.business_implication: Only manufacturers or authorized resellers can bid; resellers must have valid authorization from the manufacturer.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify and document your status as an authorized reseller for the proposed GPS hardware and software, and be prepared to provide proof of authorization.

quotes.quote: Be the original manufacturer or authorized reseller of the hardware and software to be provided;

findings.title: Compliance with Applicable Laws and Regulations
findings.fact: Bidders must be compliant with all applicable laws and regulations related to providing these services.
findings.business_implication: Non-compliance with any relevant laws or regulations could disqualify the bid.
findings.action_recommendation: Conduct a thorough compliance review to ensure your company meets all legal and regulatory requirements for providing GPS hardware and software services in New York State.

quotes.quote: Be compliant with all applicable laws and regulations related to providing these services.

findings.title: NYS Vendor File Registration Required
findings.fact: Prior to award, the Bidder must be registered in the New York State Vendor File.
findings.business_implication: Without registration in the NYS Vendor File, you cannot be awarded the contract, even if your bid is otherwise successful.
findings.action_recommendation: If not already registered, initiate the NYS Vendor File registration process immediately. If already registered, ensure your Vendor ID is correctly entered on the cover page.

quotes.quote: Prior to being awarded an Agreement pursuant to this RFQ, the Bidder(s) must be registered in the New York State Vendor File (Vendor File) administered by the Office of the State Comptroller (OSC).

findings.title: Bidder must certify understanding and agreement to abide by RFQ
findings.fact: The Bidder must certify that it has read the RFQ in its entirety and understands and agrees to abide by the requirements, terms, and conditions.
findings.business_implication: By signing the bid, you are legally bound to all terms and conditions in the RFQ, so any oversight could lead to contractual obligations you may not have intended.
findings.action_recommendation: Thoroughly review the entire RFQ, including all appendices and attachments, and ensure your organization can comply with all requirements before signing the certification.

quotes.quote: The Bidder has read the RFQ in its entirety and understands and agrees to abide by the requirements, terms, and conditions contained in the RFQ.

findings.title: Final Bid Submission Deadline
findings.fact: The final bid submission deadline is October 8, 2019 by 2:00 PM ET.
findings.business_implication: Missing the deadline will likely result in rejection of your bid, so timely submission is critical.
findings.action_recommendation: Plan to submit your bid well before the deadline to avoid last-minute technical issues. Ensure all required documents are complete and correctly formatted.

quotes.quote: BID DUE DATE: October 8, 2019
Deadline for Submission of Quotes (Cover Page and Attachments 1-4) October 8, 2019 by 2:00 PM ET
Responses to this RFQ must be emailed to BFS.Contracts@tax.ny.gov no later than October 8, 2019 at 2:00 PM ET.

findings.title: Q&A / Clarification Deadline
findings.fact: The deadline for submission of bidder questions is September 25, 2019.
findings.business_implication: Bidders must submit all clarifying questions by this date to ensure they fully understand the requirements and can prepare a compliant bid. Missing this deadline may leave ambiguities unresolved, increasing the risk of non-compliance or disqualification.
findings.action_recommendation: Review the RFQ thoroughly and submit any questions to the designated contact before September 25, 2019. Ensure all clarifications are received and incorporated into the bid preparation.

quotes.quote: Deadline for Submission of Bidder Questions September 25, 2019

findings.title: Lowest Overall Cost Award
findings.fact: The award will be made to the responsive and responsible Bidder who provides the lowest overall cost and meets all requirements set forth in this RFQ.
findings.business_implication: Price is the primary factor for award, but only among bidders who are deemed responsive and responsible. This means that even a low-priced bid can be rejected if it fails to meet all requirements, so compliance is critical.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure the bid is fully compliant with all technical and administrative requirements, while also offering the most competitive pricing. Carefully calculate total cost including all components to ensure it is the lowest among compliant bids.

quotes.quote: The award will be made to the responsive and responsible Bidder who provides the lowest overall cost and meets all requirements set forth in this RFQ.

findings.title: Disqualification for Non-Conforming Conduct/Proposal
findings.fact: The Department may disqualify any Bidder whose conduct and/or proposal fails to conform to the requirements of the RFQ.
findings.business_implication: Any deviation from the RFQ requirements, whether in conduct or proposal content, can lead to disqualification. This includes procedural missteps, non-compliant documentation, or unethical behavior.
findings.action_recommendation: Strictly adhere to all instructions in the RFQ, including submission format, required forms, and deadlines. Avoid any actions that could be perceived as non-conforming, and ensure all team members are aware of the requirements.

quotes.quote: Disqualify any Bidder whose conduct and/or proposal fails to conform to the requirements of the RFQ.

findings.title: Rejection for Failure to Submit Required Data
findings.fact: Failure to submit any of the required data may result in rejection of the bid.
findings.business_implication: Incomplete submissions are at risk of being rejected outright. The RFQ lists specific data and forms that must be included; missing any of them could lead to disqualification without the opportunity to cure.
findings.action_recommendation: Create a checklist of all required documents and data from the RFQ (e.g., detailed specifications, completed forms, certifications) and verify each is included before submission. Double-check that all attachments are complete and accurate.

quotes.quote: Failure to submit any of the above data may result in rejection of the bid.

findings.title: Disqualification for Modifying Quote Response Form
findings.fact: Any alterations of the Quote Response Form may result in a determination of non-responsiveness and disqualification of the bid.
findings.business_implication: The Quote Response Form (Attachment 1) must be used exactly as provided. Any modifications, such as changing the layout, adding terms, or altering pricing structure, can render the bid non-responsive and lead to disqualification.
findings.action_recommendation: Use the exact Quote Response Form provided in the RFQ without any modifications. Fill in the required information precisely as instructed. If there are any questions about the form, seek clarification before the deadline.

quotes.quote: Do not modify this form. Any alterations of the Quote Response Form may result in a determination of non-responsiveness and disqualification of the bid.

findings.title: Disqualification for Failure to Answer Clarifications
findings.fact: Failure to answer all clarifications or questions may delay the evaluation of your bid and may result in a determination of non-responsiveness and disqualification of the bid.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must respond promptly and completely to any clarifications or questions from the Department to avoid being deemed non-responsive and disqualified. Delays in evaluation could also affect the bid's competitiveness.
findings.action_recommendation: Designate a responsible person to monitor communications from the Department and ensure all clarifications are answered thoroughly and within the specified deadlines. Maintain a checklist to track all requests and confirmations of receipt.

quotes.quote: Failure to answer all clarifications or questions may delay the evaluation of your bid and may result in a determination of non-responsiveness and disqualification of the bid.

findings.title: Contractor Subject to Fines for Non-Discrimination Violations
findings.fact: Contractor is subject to fines of $50.00 per person per day for any violation of Section 220-e or Section 239 as well as possible termination of this contract and forfeiture of all moneys due hereunder for a second or subsequent violation.
findings.business_implication: Non-compliance with non-discrimination provisions can result in significant financial penalties and potential contract termination, which would harm the bidder's reputation and financial standing.
findings.action_recommendation: Implement robust equal employment opportunity policies and training for all staff involved in the contract. Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance with Section 220-e and Section 239, and maintain documentation of compliance efforts.

quotes.quote: Contractor is subject to fines of $50.00 per person per day for any violation of Section 220-e or Section 239 as well as possible termination of this contract and forfeiture of all moneys due hereunder for a second or subsequent violation.

findings.title: State's Set-Off Rights
findings.fact: The State shall have all of its common law, equitable and statutory rights of set-off, including the option to withhold moneys due to the Contractor under this contract up to any amounts due and owing to the State.
findings.business_implication: The State can withhold payments due under this contract to offset any debts the bidder owes to the State, including from other contracts or tax liabilities. This could impact cash flow and profitability.
findings.action_recommendation: Review the bidder's financial obligations to the State and ensure there are no outstanding debts that could trigger set-off. Maintain accurate financial records and communicate with the State regarding any potential set-off issues.

quotes.quote: The State shall have all of its common law, equitable and statutory rights of set-off. These rights shall include, but not be limited to, the State's option to withhold for the purposes of set-off any moneys due to the Contractor under this contract up to any amounts due and owing to the State with regard to this contract, any other contract with any State department or agency, including any contract for a term commencing prior to the term of this contract, plus any amounts due and owing to the State for any other reason including, without limitation, tax delinquencies, fee delinquencies or monetary penalties relative thereto.

findings.title: Contractor Must Comply with Information Security Breach and Notification Act
findings.fact: Contractor shall comply with the provisions of the New York State Information Security Breach and Notification Act (General Business Law Section 899-aa; State Technology Law Section 208).
findings.business_implication: The bidder must have robust data security measures in place to protect sensitive information and must comply with breach notification requirements, which could involve legal and reputational risks if not handled properly.
findings.action_recommendation: Review and update data security policies and procedures to align with the Act. Ensure that incident response plans include timely notification to affected parties and the State as required. Train staff on data protection and breach response.

quotes.quote: Contractor shall comply with the provisions of the New York State Information Security Breach and Notification Act (General Business Law Section 899-aa; State Technology Law Section 208).

findings.title: Contractor May Be Declared in Default for Iran Divestment Act Violations
findings.fact: If the person fails to demonstrate that it has ceased its engagement in the investment activity which is in violation of the Act within 90 days after the determination of such violation, then the state agency shall take such action as may be appropriate and provided for by law, rule, or contract, including, but not limited to, imposing sanctions, seeking compliance, recovering damages, or declaring the Contractor in default.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must ensure it does not engage in investment activities prohibited by the Iran Divestment Act, as violations could lead to sanctions, damages, or contract termination, which would be detrimental to the business.
findings.action_recommendation: Conduct due diligence on the bidder's investment portfolio and that of any subcontractors to ensure compliance with the Iran Divestment Act. If any violation is identified, take immediate steps to cease the activity and document the response to the State.

quotes.quote: If the person fails to demonstrate that it has ceased its engagement in the investment activity which is in violation of the Act within 90 days after the determination of such violation, then the state agency shall take such action as may be appropriate and provided for by law, rule, or contract, including, but not limited to, imposing sanctions, seeking compliance, recovering damages, or declaring the Contractor in default.

findings.title: Termination for Unacceptable Replacement Devices
findings.fact: The Department reserves the right to terminate the Agreement if replacement devices are deemed unacceptable.
findings.business_implication: The Department can terminate the contract if it deems replacement devices unacceptable, giving it broad discretion and creating risk for the bidder if replacements are not approved.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure replacement devices meet or exceed specifications and maintain clear communication with the Department to gain approval before substitution.

quotes.quote: The Department reserves the right to terminate the Agreement if such replacement devices are deemed unacceptable.

findings.title: Termination for False Certification
findings.fact: DTF reserves the right to terminate the Agreement if the certification filed by the Offerer/bidder was intentionally false or intentionally incomplete.
findings.business_implication: Providing false or incomplete certification can lead to termination, which could damage the bidder's reputation and result in financial loss.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure all certifications are accurate and complete; implement internal review processes to verify compliance before submission.

quotes.quote: DTF reserves the right to terminate this Agreement in the event it is found that the certification filed by the Offerer/bidder in accordance with New York State Finance Law §139-k was intentionally false or intentionally incomplete.

findings.title: Termination for International Boycott Violation
findings.fact: If the Contractor is convicted or found to have violated international boycott laws, the contract shall be rendered forfeit and void.
findings.business_implication: Violating international boycott laws can void the contract, leading to loss of revenue and potential legal consequences.
findings.action_recommendation: Conduct due diligence to ensure compliance with international boycott laws and monitor any affiliations that might trigger violations.

quotes.quote: If such Contractor, or any of the aforesaid affiliates of Contractor, is convicted or is otherwise found to have violated said laws or regulations upon the final determination of the United States Commerce Department or any other appropriate agency of the United States subsequent to the contract's execution, such contract, amendment or modification thereto shall be rendered forfeit and void.

findings.title: Termination for false certification under Procurement Lobbying Law
findings.fact: The State may terminate the agreement if the contractor's certification of compliance with State Finance Law Sections 139-j and 139-k is found to be intentionally false or intentionally incomplete.
findings.business_implication: False certification regarding procurement lobbying can lead to termination, exposing the bidder to legal and financial risks.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure all lobbying disclosures are truthful and complete; maintain records of all communications with state officials.

quotes.quote: In the event such certification is found to be intentionally false or intentionally incomplete, the State may terminate the agreement by providing written notification to the Contractor in accordance with the terms of the agreement.

findings.title: Termination for false tax registration certification
findings.fact: If the contractor fails to make the certification required by Tax Law Section 5-a or if the certification is discovered to be false, the contract may be terminated by providing written notification to the Contractor.
findings.business_implication: Failure to provide or false tax registration certification can be considered a material breach, leading to termination and potential penalties.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify tax registration status and ensure certifications are accurate; stay updated on tax law requirements.

quotes.quote: if the contractor fails to make the certification required by Tax Law Section 5-a or if during the term of the contract, the Department of Taxation and Finance or the covered agency, as defined by Tax Law 5-a, discovers that the certification, made under penalty of perjury, is false, then such failure to file or false certification shall be a material breach of this contract and this contract may be terminated, by providing written notification to the Contractor in accordance with the terms of the agreement, if the covered agency determines that such action is in the best interest of the State.
